notes.title: Deep Blue Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26903194/0b3a53f428c42a1265acad6fd68f08bea043fccf.png[/img]

Hey guys, 

There are a few things we fixed and updated in the game to make your experience better! We fixed those annoying achievement bugs some of you reported, we made some minor tweaks and fixes and we added new library assets so you can enjoy looking at Deep Blue in your library!

tags.bug: We fixed those annoying achievement bugs some of you reported

tags.feature: we added new library assets so you can enjoy looking at Deep Blue in your library!

notes.title: Major fixes and gameplay improvement
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26903194/ab055dc6516bb8342c0ac7c74547c9abb9bbfafd.gif[/img]

Hey All! Thank you for playing! We've made some bug fixing and changes in levels in the first universe so you can upgrade much faster.

Here's a full list of changes included in this update:
- Bug fixes
- First universe design changes, you can find upgrades much faster
- Some small gameplay design changes
- Deep blue weights much less
- The minimal requirements are much smaller
- Optimization of VR
